name: Ryuuguu Gaimu Gaiden 1 "Kokou no Hakuu"
original_name: 流寓街夢外伝壱「孤高の白雨」
source:
Main character gets a request to find a man on the image. He is said that when he finds the man and looks in his eyes, he will know what to do without posing any further questions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角收到要求寻找图像上的男人的请求。据说，当他找到那个人并看着他的眼睛时，他就会知道该怎么做，而无需提出任何进一步的问题。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
